استحرمت (form X)
# اِسْتَحْرَمْتُ (istaḥramtu) /is.taħ.ram.tu/: first-person singular past active of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اِسْتَحْرَمْتَ (istaḥramta) /is.taħ.ram.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اِسْتَحْرَمْتِ (istaḥramti) /is.taħ.ram.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of اِسْتَحْرَمَ (istaḥrama)
# اِسْتَحْرَمَتْ (istaḥramat) /is.t
